authoritative_primary_provenance.criterion: Government, institutional repository, official solver project or original experimental publication with persistent identifier.

lawful_open_access_and_license.criterion: Public access is verified and reuse/license terms for acquired model files are explicit; public-read-only access to a report alone is insufficient for a deck.

bounded_downloadable_deck_or_reconstruct.criterion: A solver input deck is downloadable, or geometry, mesh, materials, boundary/initial conditions and contacts are complete enough for deterministic reconstruction without generic substitutions.

failure_and_regularization_complete.criterion: Failure/erosion law, all parameters, units and any characteristic length, nonlocal treatment or objective damage-energy rule are explicit; a bare deletion strain is insufficient.

measured_validation_outputs.criterion: At least one measured time history or final quantitative observable relevant to impact transfer is available with units and test conditions, such as force, impulse, residual velocity, deformation or perforation.

mesh_and_convergence_definition.criterion: At least three documented mesh levels or an explicit convergence/uncertainty study exists for force, impulse, residual velocity, deformation or another predeclared impact observable.

local_execution_feasible_and_bounded.criterion: The case is compatible with an available local solver or has a documented conversion route, and a later qualification run is estimated below 60 minutes per mesh on CPU without a multi-hour GPU job.

candidate_matrix.title: Development of a Generic Gas-Turbine Engine Fan Blade-Out Full-Fan Rig Model

authoritative_primary_provenance.reason: FAA primary report in the USDOT ROSA P repository with DOI and report number.

lawful_open_access_and_license.reason: The report is publicly readable, but the repository supplies no model file with explicit reuse terms.

bounded_downloadable_deck_or_reconstruct.reason: No LS-DYNA deck or complete CAD/mesh definition is listed, and the full rig cannot be deterministically reconstructed from report figures alone.

failure_and_regularization_complete.reason: Johnson-Cook and constant-strain deletion are documented, but the report explicitly finds mesh/event-dependent tuning and supplies no objective damage-energy or characteristic-length regularization.

measured_validation_outputs.reason: Consistency with reported FBO tests is qualitative; no paired measured time history or fully specified quantitative rig-test comparator is exposed.

mesh_and_convergence_definition.reason: Three blade meshes are not a nested convergence sequence and change the fragmentation result; only two casing thickness meshes are compared for strain energy.

local_execution_feasible_and_bounded.reason: The required proprietary LS-DYNA deck is absent and reported full-model runtimes greatly exceed the 60-minute-per-mesh ceiling.
